byte_convention: HONEST FOUR-PART TOTAL, uncompressed raw array bytes, SUMMED AND NEVER NETTED: (1) atoms = sum_k modes_k.size x 4 B (float32, the deployed content); (2) covariance + count = sum_k stat_floats_k x 8 B (float64 -- the precision actually retained; counting it at 4 would be netting by dtype) + 11,488 B of count table; (3) address book = TensorAddress.byte_ledger()['address_bytes']; (4) coupling/hole table = 5,288 + 1,322 = 6,610 B. No entropy coding, no deduplication, no subtraction of any part from any other. The 524,288 B pin is a REFERENCE COLUMN for continuity with waves 5-8, NOT a budget in this sweep.
